statement.latest: \text{For a declared drainage node } U \text{ (PROP-FLOOD-06 unit), window } H \text{ (hours), all on } \mathbb{Q}: \quad \boxed{C^{des}_H(U) := D_{design}(U,H)\cdot A_U} \text{ (design capacity, 08-local, in place of 06's } C_H\text{; not a case of 06) only when the owner has declared a design depth for exactly window } H \text{ (e.g. BMA 2569 p.63: } H{=}1\mapsto 58.7\text{ mm}, H{=}24\mapsto 80\text{ mm), else REFUSED DESIGN\_DEPTH\_UNDECLARED; no pro-rating between windows.} \quad \boxed{L^m_H(U) := \dfrac{c_U P^m_H(U) + \kappa\,E_k(U)/A_U}{D_{design}(U,H)}}\ (\kappa = 1000\text{ mm/m for } E_k\text{ in m}^3, A_U \text{ in m}^2) \text{ per named model } m, \text{ reported worst first } (L_H:=\max_m L^m_H, \text{ attained}), \text{ never averaged; interval form } [L(x^{lo*}),L(x^{hi*})] \text{ by PROP-FLOOD-10a (non-decreasing in } P,c,E; \text{ non-increasing in } D_{design}). \quad \boxed{E_k(U) := \max(0,\, S_k(U) - S_{safe}(U))} \text{ on PROP-FLOOD-03 state, one declared unit/datum; REFUSED SAFE\_STORAGE\_UNDECLARED | DATUM\_UNDECLARED | 03 codes (first).} \quad \boxed{T_{dd}(U) := V_{stored}(U)/Q_{out}(U)} \text{; at } Q_{out}=Q_{max} \text{ (declared maximum/rated outflow over the horizon) it is a LOWER bound on real drawdown; at an effective (current) } Q_{out} \text{ it is a readout, NOT a bound; REFUSED MISSING\_INPUT, NEGATIVE\_STORAGE, ZERO\_OUTFLOW (} Q_{out}\le 0\text{; a non-value, never } \infty). \quad C_{eff}=C_0\,\eta,\ \eta = g_U(t)\cdot(\text{running-pump fraction})\cdot\eta_{canal},\ \eta_{canal} \text{ ABSENT until fitted; } L \text{ at rated capacity is a lower bound for every } \eta\in(0,1].
statement.note_ascii: NEW DERIVATION / PROPOSAL -- not yet in Toledo. Four deltas over PROP-FLOOD-03 and PROP-FLOOD-06 v6.1, interval form via PROP-FLOOD-10a. (1) Design capacity C_des_H(U) (08-local; in place of 06's C_H, never a case of 06's case split): C_des_H(U) := D_design(U,H)*A_U, DESIGN_DECLARED PER WINDOW, using the owner's declared design depth D_design(U,H) for exactly the window H (Bangkok, BMA drainage plan 2569 p.63, VERIFIED downstream: 1 h -> 58.7 mm, 24 h -> 80 mm); any other window is REFUSED DESIGN_DEPTH_UNDECLARED -- no pro-rating, no bridging between windows (the v0 draft's (H/24)*D_design gave 3.33 mm at H = 1 h, contradicting the owner's 58.7 mm and violating downstream conversion rule R2). Load-to-capacity ratio L^m_H = (c_U*P^m_H + kappa*E_k/A_U)/D_design(U,H), with kappa = 1000 mm/m when E_k is in m^3 and A_U in m^2 (equivalently E_k[m^3]/A_U[km^2] x 1e-3 mm), so the numerator is in mm like D_design; per named model, worst first (the worst bounds every model and is one of them), never averaged; with E_k REFUSED the rain-only ratio is reported as a MINIMUM (proved lower bound). c_U = 1 (PROP-FLOOD-06 bound-pair upper end) unless measured. (2) Storage exceedance E_k = max(0, S_k - S_safe) on ONE declared unit/datum: REFUSED SAFE_STORAGE_UNDECLARED (reference not declared), DATUM_UNDECLARED (reading and reference not on one unit/datum), 03 codes pass through first (a NEGATIVE_STORAGE ledger is never clipped to 0). Public label 'water debt' only; SIGN WARNING: 'storage deficit' in international usage means AVAILABLE storage (free room), the opposite sign -- E_k is 0 whenever room is available. PROP-FLOOD-10 level-3 point depth max(0, H - z) is an OCCURRENCE of this object (length unit, same-datum rule), not a twin. (3) Drawdown time T_dd = V_stored/Q_out, the closed form of PROP-FLOOD-03 with P = Q_in = 0 and constant Q_out; LOWER bound only when Q_out is the declared maximum (rated) outflow over the horizon: proved that with any non-negative inflow and outflow never above that Q_out, storage cannot reach 0 before tick k with k*tau >= T_dd (drawdown_is_lower_bound, whose hypothesis is outflow j <= Q_out for every tick). T_dd at an effective (current) Q_out is a readout, NOT a bound -- more pumps or a gate opening can raise outflow later; drawdown_rated_le_effective shows T_dd(rated) <= T_dd(effective). (4) Capacity reduction eta: C_eff = C_0*eta, eta = g_U(t) (06) * running-pump fraction (06) * eta_canal, eta_canal ABSENT (no default 1) until fitted via PROP-FLOOD-06 calibration_procedure; L at rated capacity is a proved lower bound for every eta in (0,1]. Not objects: the revolving screen max(0, D + P - 80) (screening heuristic, freezes A*c = 1 and Q_out*tau = 80 mm); the relayed 'multi-day envelope' P_n/(n*80) is WITHDRAWN (it pro-rates across windows; evaluate L_24 day by day and carry storage through E_k instead); no compound-interest factor.

definitions.U: declared drainage node (sub-polder, pond, district, city) exactly as PROP-FLOOD-06's unit; a city is the sum over its outfalls, per PROP-FLOOD-06 R_H summation over O_U
definitions.D_design(U,H): owner-published design rainfall depth for EXACTLY window H (a finite declared table of (window, depth) pairs, each with a source tag). Bangkok: (1 h, 58.7 mm) and (24 h, 80 mm), BMA drainage plan 2569 p.63, VERIFIED downstream; the two numbers are separately declared (downstream R2 check: T=2y gives 1 h 58.7 mm but 24 h 93.6 mm, so 80 is not the same-T 24 h value) and are never converted into each other. A window without an entry (2, 3, 6, 12 h, n days) is REFUSED DESIGN_DEPTH_UNDECLARED. Using a city figure for a smaller node is a scope borrow tagged RELAYED-scope.
definitions.P^m_H(U): forecast or observed rainfall depth over the same window H from named source m (model or gauge); a forecast value is a grid-cell MEAN per PROP-FLOOD-06 v6.1 forecast_grid_cell_mean; per source, worst first, never averaged (multi_model_scenarios)
definitions.c_U: runoff coefficient, PROP-FLOOD-06 bound pair [0.5, 1]; the load ratio uses the upper end 1 unless measured; the interval form carries the pair
definitions.E_k(U): storage exceedance max(0, S_k - S_safe) on one declared unit/datum; in L it enters as kappa*E_k/A_U with kappa = 1000 mm/m (E_k in m^3, A_U in m^2), i.e. in mm like D_design; REFUSED -> L reported as the rain-only MINIMUM with missing: storage_state
definitions.S_safe(U): owner-declared safe reference on the same unit/datum as S_k (a volume for storage; a bankfull capacity is not a safe storage; a stage is not a volume without a declared stage-storage relation on a declared datum)
definitions.V_stored(U): declared or official stored volume at drawdown start (m^3)
definitions.Q_out(U): outflow rate (m^3/s) = PROP-FLOOD-03 Q_out rule (0 if gate CLOSED else min(Q_meas, C_pump)); labelled rated|effective
definitions.eta: capacity reduction factor C_eff/C_0 in (0,1]: g_U(t) * running-pump fraction (both PROP-FLOOD-06) * eta_canal (slot, ABSENT until fitted; no default)
definitions.T_dd(U): drawdown time V_stored/Q_out in seconds (report also in h and d); a lower bound only at Q_out = declared maximum (rated) outflow; at an effective Q_out a readout, not a bound

claim_boundary: Finite bookkeeping readouts of PROP-FLOOD-03's ledger and PROP-FLOOD-06's ratio: no routing, no Saint-Venant, no rating curve, no rainfall-runoff model beyond c_U. D_design(U,H) is an owner declaration per window, not a derived flood-onset boundary. The ratio is defined only at owner-declared windows.
non_claims: No hourly intensity is inferred from a 24 h total and no 24 h depth from an hourly one: windows are never pro-rated (the only relation between a 24 h total P_24 and any hour is 0 <= P_1h <= P_24, a bound, which almost always gives POSSIBLE).
E_k is not 'storage deficit' (international usage: available storage, opposite sign), and E_k = 0 means 'no exceedance', not 'safe'.

T_dd at the declared maximum (rated) outflow is a lower bound, never an estimate of real drawdown time; T_dd at an effective outflow is a readout, not a bound (outflow may rise later) and not an estimate either.
No point depth without water level H and ground elevation z on one declared datum (PROP-FLOOD-10 level 3 applies the same-datum rule).
No forecast-skill claim: a forecast-only L (about 0.66 on 26 Sep 2569) missed an observed L_24 of 2.54; one event calibrates nothing.
The screen max(0, D + P - 80) is a screening heuristic (monotone, but not a readout of storage); the relayed multi-day envelope P_n/(n*80) is withdrawn.
No compound-interest term: any 'old water lowers future drainage' effect must appear in a measured Q_out or eta.

falsifier: (1) Systematic tier/outcome mismatch across replayed independent events for a unit class (observed L_H >= 1 repeatedly without flooding, or < 1 repeatedly with flooding, per declared window) falsifies D_design(U,H) as effective capacity for that class and window, not the arithmetic; fix via PROP-FLOOD-06 calibration_procedure, never by a silent constant change or by pro-rating another window. (2) Observed drain-down faster than T_dd at rated outflow falsifies the declared V_stored or outlet set (UNDECLARED_EDGE candidate) -- the Coq lower bound rules it out under its hypotheses. (3) Measured eta = 1 under full canals across >= 3 events retires the eta_canal slot for that node class; measured eta < 1 with running pumps confirms it.
